text.text: I'm a growth and lifecycle product manager. I pair funnel analytics with direct user feedback to find where activation, adoption, or retention breaks down, then build the product changes that fix it.

My public health background shapes how I read that data. It trained me to look past the individual drop-off point to the system causing it, and to combine quantitative patterns with the qualitative why behind them. I bring that lens to consumer health, travel, and subscription products, the sectors where growth depends entirely on moving a cohort from first use to habit.
I'm also a hands-on builder. I use Claude Code and Cowork to prototype product changes, build data models, and test ideas directly rather than only speccing them.
I'm open to conversations about growth, lifecycle, and product operations roles, particularly in consumer health, travel, and subscription products.
Columbia University · Master of Public Health (MPH)

I'm looking for growth and lifecycle product roles in consumer health, travel tech, or subscription products. Currently based in California, open to relocating to SoCal. Prefer in-person, open to remote.
